item.title: Hacking Growth
item.description: Author: Fan Bing Subtitle: A Secret Playbook for User and Revenue Growth in Startups Publication year: 2015-7 ISBN: 9787121263606 Notes: This is a fairly marketing-oriented book aimed at ToC internet products. Through all kinds of real cases, it shows you the playbook of internet products: how to create a product, acquire users, spark activity, improve retention, increase revenue, and spread virally.
